versions.changelog:
- Added support for comprehensive SQL statement checking for Apache Doris, including both syntax validation and specification compliance.
- Implements custom Doris SQL tokenizer and recursive descent parser based on Doris 3.1.4 Nereids ANTLR4 grammar.
- Supports 100+ Doris statement types, Doris-specific syntax elements, and enforces best practices.
- Offers two check modes: Syntax Check (validity and compatibility) and Specification Check (object/naming/design standards), with "all" (default) to run both.
- Processes SQL locally with no external dependencies or data transmission.
